_readme: Copy this file to settings.json (same directory) and edit the 3 required fields: vault_dir, project_dir, python_cmd. python_cmd is the ABSOLUTE path to the python of this skill's own conda env (see README: conda create -n paper-kb python=3.10 -y; PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt) — every tool, the MCP server and both hooks run on it. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Use forward slashes / even on Windows. Then run: paper-kb-deploy  (or: python deploy.py)
